summary: Pick one of two to five options, all visible at once. A radio group drawn as a segmented track — it sets a value and controls no panel.
useWhen: switching how the same content is shown — List / Board / Calendar
a short, fixed set of mutually exclusive settings — Day / Week / Month, °C / °F
a filter with a few exclusive choices where seeing every option matters

useInstead.when: each option shows a different panel of content
useInstead.why: Tabs wires each tab to its panel with tablist/tabpanel semantics. A SegmentedControl controls no region, so a screen-reader user is never told which content changed

useInstead.when: there are more than five options, or the labels are long
useInstead.why: segments do not wrap; a track that overflows hides the options it exists to show

useInstead.when: the choice sits in a form with a visible question and descriptions per option
useInstead.why: same semantics, but room for a label and helper text on each option

useInstead.when: the setting is a single on/off
the options trigger actions rather than set a value — Bold, Italic
useInstead.why: an action is not a selection; a radio group announces a state that does not exist

lg.use: a primary view switch at the top of a page

children.note: two to five. One item is not a choice; six is a Select

requires: `label` — the group's accessible name. Hidden by default; `showLabel` renders it above the track
guarantees: one tab stop for the whole control; arrow keys move and select, skipping disabled segments
built from real radio inputs, so it announces "2 of 3, selected" and submits with a form under `name`
a disabled selected segment keeps its selected surface — a disabled control still has a value
notes: it looks exactly like Tabs' pill type on purpose, and behaves differently on purpose. Choose by what changes, not by how it looks

antiPatterns.dont: a SegmentedControl that swaps the panel below it
antiPatterns.why: the panel relationship is exactly what tabpanel semantics announce; without it the content changes silently
a segmented track with nothing selected reads as broken, not as a choice still to make
each segment is a radio, and an unnamed radio is announced as just "radio button"
